answer_1.quote: Text-to-SQL  aims to enable non-expert users to retrieve data effortlessly by automatically translating natural language questions into accurate SQL queries.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the ability of Text-to-SQL using the Execution Accuracy: • Execution Accuracy(EX). This metric is widely used to evaluate the quality of the generated SQL , based on the comparison with the results of the Gold SQL execution.

answer_4.quote: We manually examined the erroneous samples and identified four error types, which further highlight the two key challenges presented in the Introduction.
answer_4.guideline: The manual examination involved identifying error types related to schema linking, specifically: Target Database without Retrieval, Referring Irrelevant Databases, Linking to the Wrong Tables, and Linking to the Wrong Columns.
